requirements.name: Count
requirements.required: 4 a board, one per TPS55285
requirements.datasheet: one D flip-flop with asynchronous clear a part
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, section 3

requirements.name: Set by the sensor's alert, set dominant
requirements.required: the MCP9808 alert sets the latch as a level; while the alert is asserted a clear does not release the rail
requirements.datasheet: CLR low forces Q low whatever the clock and D (Table 1): the alert (active low) on CLR holds 'tripped' = Q low while asserted
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, Table 1 function table

requirements.name: Cleared only by F11
requirements.required: stays set until the operator clear control (F11) clears it; no firmware clear
requirements.datasheet: with D tied HIGH and CLR high, the rising edge on CLK loads Q HIGH; no other input clears
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, Table 1

requirements.name: Holds only its own converter off
requirements.required: its output takes that converter's EN/UVLO below 0.4 V (VEN_L) through the enable combination; the other rails and the ESC keep running
requirements.datasheet: VOL 0.1 V max at 100 uA, 0.4 V max at 16 mA (VCC 3 V); Q low drives the enable AND, whose part is not selected
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, section 6.5

requirements.name: Defined state at power-up
requirements.required: a defined state after power-up through an asynchronous input, held until the 3.3 V rail is in range
requirements.datasheet: no power-up state stated; CLR held LOW at power-up gives Q low
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, Table 1

requirements.name: I_off on inputs
requirements.required: I_off on inputs that the interlock's F11 clear line drives
requirements.datasheet: Ioff +/-10 uA max at VCC 0 V, VI or VO 5.5 V (the Nexperia part states +/-2 uA)
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, section 6.5

requirements.name: Supply
requirements.datasheet: VCC 1.65 to 5.5 V
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, section 6.3

requirements.name: Clear edge
requirements.required: the F11 clear's debounced edge reaches the clock within its input transition limit (R3's Schmitt buffer SN74AUP1G17 already shapes it)
requirements.datasheet: input transition rise or fall rate 10 ns/V max at VCC 3.3 V +/-0.3 V; takes R3's buffered F11 edge
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, recommended operating conditions

requirements.name: Ambient range
requirements.required: 0 to 50 degC
requirements.datasheet: TA -40 to +125 degC
requirements.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74lvc1g175.pdf (HTTP 200, 2026-10-02T18:37:19Z), SCES560G, revised June 2015, recommended operating conditions
